title: Hawaii, 8:07 AM, January 13, 2018
summary: The false ballistic missile alert, exactly as it was sent, proposed again as a live alert.
what_to_expect: Held. There is no National Weather Service or military source, so two officers must approve; no area was drawn; and no correction is staged.
